summary: PEPE +11% 24h after Arkham showed Justin Sun-linked wallets accumulating ~$51M (2.8% of supply) via Poloniex withdrawals on 17 and 26 Oct. Possibly internal transfers since Sun owns Poloniex, so the 'whale buying' read is shaky. Buzz spike on a coin that has already run, which is a chase risk, not a clean bullish signal.
catalyst_note: No verifiable dated catalyst (wallet flows may be internal exchange moves)
